# Living room dashboard

Run a room without opening a dialog. Switches, sliders, steppers, speeds and your own scene buttons sit right on the cards ([controls](/cards/controls)), [rules](/cards/look#rules) colour every value, and gauges, columns, bars and curves show where it stands. Every card runs against a simulated home, so tap, drag and hold them.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 4
  cards:
    - type: custom:heading-card-pro
      style: hero
      title: Living room
      subtitle: "{{ states('sensor.living_room_temperature') }} °C · {{ states('sensor.living_room_humidity') }} % humidity · {{ states('sensor.living_room_co2') }} ppm CO₂"
      badge_style: plain
      badge_size: l
      badges:
        - { value: "{{ now().strftime('%H:%M') }}", icon: false, tap_action: { action: none } }
    - type: custom:layout-card-pro
      columns: 2
      breakpoints:
        2: { columns: 4 }
      cards:
        - type: custom:tile-group-card-pro
          title: Scenes & modes
          icon: mdi:palette
          layout: row
          view_layout: { span: { 1: 2, 2: 4, 3: [2, 4] } }
          tiles:
            - { entity: scene.bright, name: Bright, icon: mdi:white-balance-sunny, color: amber, show_value: false }
            - { entity: scene.dimmed, name: Dimmed, icon: mdi:lightbulb-on-50, color: orange, show_value: false }
            - { entity: scene.dinner, name: Dinner, icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife, color: deep-orange, show_value: false }
            - { entity: scene.movie_night, name: Movie, icon: mdi:movie-open, color: deep-purple, show_value: false }
            - { entity: input_boolean.night_mode, name: Night, show_value: false, rules: [{ state: "on", color: indigo }] }
            - { entity: input_boolean.guest_mode, name: Guests, show_value: false, rules: [{ state: "on", color: pink }] }
            - { entity: input_boolean.away_mode, name: Away, show_value: false, rules: [{ state: "on", color: blue }] }
            - { entity: input_boolean.vacation_mode, name: Vacation, show_value: false, rules: [{ state: "on", color: teal }] }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_temperature
          name: Temperature
          view_layout: { span: { 1: 1, 3: [1, 4] } }
          decimals: 1
          visual: { type: sparkline, hours: 24 }
          rules:
            - { below: 18, color: blue, status: Cool }
            - { below: 24, color: green, status: Comfortable }
            - { above: 24, color: orange, status: Warm }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_humidity
          name: Humidity
          view_layout: { span: { 1: 1, 3: [1, 4] } }
          decimals: 0
          visual: gauge
          min: 0
          max: 100
          rules:
            - { below: 40, color: amber, status: Dry }
            - { below: 60, color: teal, status: Good }
            - { above: 60, color: blue, status: Humid }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: light.living_room
          name: Ceiling
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: light.desk_lamp
          name: Desk lamp
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: light.dining_table
          name: Dining table
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: cover.living_room_blinds
          name: Blinds
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: sensor.living_room_co2
          name: Air
          visual: { type: columns, hours: 12, bucket: 30 }
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: climate.living_room
          name: Thermostat
        - type: custom:poster-card-pro
          entity: fan.living_room
          name: Fan
        - type: custom:layout-card-pro
          rows: [1fr, 1fr, 1fr]
          view_layout: { span: { 1: 1, 3: [1, 3] } }
          cards:
            - type: custom:tile-card-pro
              entity: media_player.living_room_speaker
              name: Music
            - type: custom:tile-card-pro
              entity: media_player.kitchen_speaker
              name: Speaker
            - type: custom:tile-card-pro
              entity: switch.coffee_machine
              name: Coffee machine
              icon: mdi:coffee
              color: brown
              control: false
```
